Z_CAPTURE: A final list-size-3 survivor adjacent to residual Y0 cannot have originated from X/X0 by monotonicity of seed-derived lists.
If it originated in old Y0, obtaining list size 3 requires a new-seed neighbor; Lemma5 excludes simultaneous new-seed and residual-Y0 adjacency. Therefore it originated in old Y.
Distinct 3-lists L0,L' on four colors intersect in two colors. Two distinct selected colors in L0 cannot both be outside L'; at least one selected ci lies in L'.
Survival at list size 3 forces nonadjacency to the corresponding yi; therefore source Z(L') membership follows.
Y0_COMPONENT_UNIFORMITY: Axiom (iv) forbids survivor v from being mixed on any edge of Y0.
If v were mixed on a connected Y0 component, a boundary edge between N(v) and its complement exists in that component, contradiction.
independent_recomputation.HARD_CORE: After quotienting only by exact equality of the bounded coarse coordinates, any further unbounded distinction must occur in residual-Y0 component-incidence or survivor-relational data.
